scientific_intent.scientific_task: Intended task: find three planar unit-link joint angles whose forward-kinematics endpoint reaches a target; actual native executable does not implement valid position-updating CCD
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: Intended cyclic coordinate descent should rotate joints and update chain geometry. Actual source repeatedly measures angles from frozen straight pose, clips±30degrees, assigns/prefix-sums results; after loop2+, output(A,B+2A,C+3B+6A).
scientific_intent.discretization: Three unit-length planar segments and independent2D target coordinates. Named behavior fixture513 finite nonsingular targets, including reachable/unreachable coordinates and explicit mathematical defect witnesses.
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: Behavioral verification only: all1539 actual degree outputs agree with untouched nativeCPU and independent Float64 closed form within original actual checker tolerance1e-3. This does NOT establish inverse-kinematics accuracy. Native target(0,3) produces(30,90,300)degrees with FK residual1.15747 under relative-joint or2.73205 under absolute-segment interpretation.
scientific_intent.input_size_regime: 513 targets,128threads5blocks,100 repeated full25-loop calls. Historical genuine CCD and a corrected fullCCD native secondary study are not measured in this configuration.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: SourceFloat32 norms/acos and degree conversion with clamping; CPUclosedform usesFloat64atan2. Source singular target/pivot coincidences can produceNaN, and original source checker isNaN-blind; explicitly excluded from this finite behavior fixture, preserved diagnostic witness.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Planar robot-arm target positioning is the source-grounded intended use. These results must not guide a robotics solver choice: they reproduce an established source defect rather than a valid controller or converged IK solution.
scientific_intent.description: Known native scientific-defect stratum. The study preserves executable behavior for cross-framework evidence while excluding it from faithful-scientific-operator and performance-recommendation aggregates. Genuine historical CUDAjl actually recomputes forward geometry and remains intact in archived/guarded entries; it is not equivalent to this native behavior configuration.
scientific_intent.provenance: Unchanged sourceCPU and GPU both never update xData/yData, and actual GPUwitnesses establish failed forward kinematics. Root explicitly requested native-behavior translations with known-defect flags and a separate correctCCD repair backlog, not wholesale native replacement under an untouched label.
